requirements.quote:
Description: This option indicates that the BGP FSM will
                      passively wait for the remote BGP peer to
                      establish the BGP TCP connection.
requirements.condition: The passive-wait option described in this fragment is enabled.
requirements.required_behavior: Passively wait for the remote BGP peer to establish the BGP TCP connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Passive connection initiation can be checked, but this fragment omits the option name and enabling context.

requirements.quote:
Description: This option indicates that the BGP FSM will
                      passively wait for the remote BGP peer to
                      establish the BGP TCP connection.

         value:       TRUE or FALSE
requirements.condition: The unnamed passive-wait optional attribute in this fragment is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Restrict its value to TRUE or FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The value domain is checkable, but the associated option name is outside this chunk.

requirements.quote:
Description: The BGP FSM normally tracks the end result of a
                      TCP connection attempt rather than individual TCP
                      messages.  Optionally, the BGP FSM can support
                      additional interaction with the TCP connection
                      negotiation.  The interaction with the TCP events
                      may increase the amount of logging the BGP peer
                      connection requires and the number of BGP FSM
                      changes.
requirements.condition: Normal BGP FSM operation without optional tracking of individual TCP negotiation events.
requirements.required_behavior: Track the end result of a TCP connection attempt.
requirements.why_checkable: The TCP-to-FSM event interface identifies whether results or individual negotiation messages drive the FSM.

requirements.quote:
Option 2:    TrackTcpState

         Description: The BGP FSM normally tracks the end result of a
                      TCP connection attempt rather than individual TCP
                      messages.  Optionally, the BGP FSM can support
                      additional interaction with the TCP connection
                      negotiation.  The interaction with the TCP events
                      may increase the amount of logging the BGP peer
                      connection requires and the number of BGP FSM
                      changes.
requirements.condition: The implementation elects to support TrackTcpState.
requirements.required_behavior: Optionally support additional interaction between the BGP FSM and TCP connection negotiation.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional TCP negotiation event hooks are observable; this permission does not require all implementations to enable them.

requirements.quote:
Option 1:     DelayOpen

         Description: The DelayOpen optional session attribute allows
                      implementations to be configured to delay sending
                      an OPEN message for a specific time period
                      (DelayOpenTime).  The delay allows the remote BGP
                      Peer time to send the first OPEN message.
requirements.condition: The implementation supports and enables the DelayOpen optional session attribute.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow configuration to delay sending an OPEN message for the specified DelayOpenTime period.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured delay can be compared with the time at which an OPEN is sent.

         Description: The DelayOpenTime is the initial value set in the
                      DelayOpenTimer.
requirements.condition: DelayOpenTimer is initialized.
requirements.required_behavior: Set its initial value to DelayOpenTime.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer initialization can be compared with the configured DelayOpenTime.

requirements.quote:

requirements.why_checkable: The timer configuration unit and conversion logic can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Option 4:    SendNOTIFICATIONwithoutOPEN

         Description: The SendNOTIFICATIONwithoutOPEN allows a peer to
                      send a NOTIFICATION without first sending an OPEN
                      message.  Without this optional session attribute,
                      the BGP connection assumes that an OPEN message
                      must be sent by a peer prior to the peer sending a
                      NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.condition: SendNOTIFICATIONwithoutOPEN is enabled.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit a peer to send a NOTIFICATION without first sending an OPEN message.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional path can be exercised before an OPEN has been transmitted.

requirements.quote:
Description: The SendNOTIFICATIONwithoutOPEN allows a peer to
                      send a NOTIFICATION without first sending an OPEN
                      message.  Without this optional session attribute,
                      the BGP connection assumes that an OPEN message
                      must be sent by a peer prior to the peer sending a
                      NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.condition: SendNOTIFICATIONwithoutOPEN is absent or disabled and the peer sends a NOTIFICATION.
requirements.required_behavior: Send an OPEN message before sending the NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.why_checkable: The outbound message sequence identifies whether OPEN preceded NOTIFICATION.

requirements.quote:
Description: Normally, a Detect Collision (see Section 6.8)
                      will be ignored in the Established state.  This
                      optional session attribute indicates that this BGP
                      connection processes collisions in the Established
                      state.
requirements.condition: A collision is detected in the Established state during normal operation without CollisionDetectEstablishedState enabled.
requirements.required_behavior: Ignore Detect Collision in the Established state.
requirements.why_checkable: The Established-state collision-event handler can be inspected and stimulated.

requirements.quote:

         Description: Normally, a Detect Collision (see Section 6.8)

                      optional session attribute indicates that this BGP
                      connection processes collisions in the Established
                      state.
requirements.condition: CollisionDetectEstablishedState is enabled and the BGP connection is in the Established state.
requirements.required_behavior: Process collisions in the Established state.
requirements.why_checkable: The option-dependent Established-state collision-event path is observable.

requirements.quote:
Note: The optional session attributes clarify the BGP FSM
            description for existing features of BGP implementations.
            The optional session attributes may be pre-defined for an
            implementation and not readable via management interfaces
            for existing correct implementations.  As newer BGP MIBs
            (version 2 and beyond) are supported, these fields will be
            accessible via a management interface.
requirements.condition: An existing correct implementation defines optional session attributes.
requirements.required_behavior: The optional session attributes may be predefined for the implementation.
requirements.why_checkable: Predefined attribute storage is a concrete allowed implementation choice, not an obligation to provide runtime configurability.
